glossary.definition: (A) "Certificate of limited partnership" means the certificate referred to in section 1782.08 of the Revised Code, and the certificate as amended or restated.
glossary.scope: Unless the context requires a different meaning, as used in this chapter:

glossary.definition: (B) "Contribution" means any cash, property, services rendered, or promissory note or other binding obligation to contribute cash or property or to perform services, that a partner contributes to a limited partnership in his capacity as a partner.
glossary.scope: Unless the context requires a different meaning, as used in this chapter:
Unless the context requires a different meaning, as used in this chapter:

glossary.definition: (D) "Event of withdrawal of a general partner" means an event that causes a person to cease to be a general partner as provided in section 1782.23 of the Revised Code.
glossary.normalized: event of withdrawal of a general partner
glossary.scope: Unless the context requires a different meaning, as used in this chapter:
glossary.term: Event of withdrawal of a general partner

glossary.definition: (E) "Foreign limited partnership" means a limited partnership formed under the laws of any state other than this state.
glossary.scope: Unless the context requires a different meaning, as used in this chapter:

glossary.definition: (F) "General partner" means a person who has been admitted to a limited partnership as a general partner in accordance with the partnership agreement and named in the certificate of limited partnership as a general partner.
glossary.scope: Unless the context requires a different meaning, as used in this chapter:

glossary.definition: (G) "Limited partner" means a person who has been admitted to a limited partnership as a limited partner in accordance with the partnership agreement.
glossary.scope: Unless the context requires a different meaning, as used in this chapter:

glossary.definition: (H) "Limited partnership" and "domestic limited partnership" mean a partnership formed by two or more persons under the laws of this state, having as members one or more general partners and one or more limited partners.
glossary.scope: Unless the context requires a different meaning, as used in this chapter:

glossary.definition: (H) "Limited partnership" and "domestic limited partnership" mean a partnership formed by two or more persons under the laws of this state, having as members one or more general partners and one or more limited partners.
glossary.scope: Unless the context requires a different meaning, as used in this chapter:

glossary.definition: (I) "Liquidating trustee" means a person, other than a general partner but including a limited partner, who is carrying out the winding up of a limited partnership.
glossary.scope: Unless the context requires a different meaning, as used in this chapter:

glossary.definition: (J) "Partner" means a limited or general partner.
glossary.scope: Unless the context requires a different meaning, as used in this chapter:

glossary.definition: (K) "Partnership agreement" means any valid written or oral agreement of the partners as to the affairs of a limited partnership and the conduct of its business.
glossary.scope: Unless the context requires a different meaning, as used in this chapter:

glossary.definition: (L) "Partnership interest" means a partner's share of the profits and losses of a limited partnership and the right to receive distributions of partnership assets.
glossary.scope: Unless the context requires a different meaning, as used in this chapter:

glossary.definition: (M) "Person" means any natural person; partnership, limited partnership, trust, estate, association, limited liability company, or corporation; any custodian, nominee, trustee, executor, administrator, or other fiduciary; or any other individual or entity in its own or any representative capacity.
